name: Ozil Goal AI Trend: Score the Famous Solo Goal Yourself
blurb: The Ozil goal AI trend remakes a famous 2016 solo goal with someone else as the scorer: a grandma, a game character, a friend or you.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.0 Mini, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text: [Video 1] is a motion guide only. Copy its camera moves, timing and actions, the night stadium under floodlights, the dark packed stands and the green pitch. Do NOT copy the people in [Video 1]: not their faces, hair, skin tone, age or clothes. Replace all of them. The one with the ball the whole time, who dribbles toward the camera, flicks the ball over the goalkeeper as he dives, takes the falling ball on the chest, lets it bounce, waits while two defenders slide past on the grass and then shoots the ball along the grass into the net, is the one in [Image 1]. Keep the face, hair, skin tone, body, clothes and shoes from [Image 1] in every shot, with no headscarf, no cardigan and no floral dress unless [Image 1] shows them. The goalkeeper in a plain grey kit and the defenders in plain blue kits are new adult men, not the ones in [Video 1]. The ball is a plain white football. Photorealistic, like a real night match filmed from pitch level. One continuous shot that ends behind the goal as the ball rolls into the net. No text, no names or numbers on the shirts, no badges, no score graphics, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra limbs.
